name: Junie CLI
description: A fully standalone command-line interface for JetBrains' AI agent, previously only available as an IDE extension. Junie CLI supports macOS, Linux, and Windows, with support for models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Grok, priced from $10/month for individuals.

name: JetBrains Air
description: An agentic AI development environment built on the foundation of the abandoned Fleet IDE. Air delegates tasks to multiple AI agents running concurrently, supporting OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Agent, Google Gemini CLI, and JetBrains Junie through the Agent Client Protocol (ACP).
community_quotes: Community reacts with mixed feelings about JetBrains Air
JetBrains believes agents are changing how software is made, and Air is designed to delegate tasks to multiple AI agents running concurrently
